execution_method: Root-orchestrated subagent execution, sequential task ownership, test-first and independent review; no worker git/RS/scheduler/remote/source publication.

models.Sol: All semantic/authority/codec/alias/guard/resource validation implementation and independent review
models.Terra: Only explicitly bounded mechanical manifest/hash/diff/AST/syntax packaging after semantic source is frozen; no design or acceptance rulings

unchanged_critical_interfaces: workload.build_inventory and derive_storage_requirements algorithms as accepted765

interfaces._publish_prepared_target_object(path, pa: CPU-only exact-format atomic writer using common.publish and artifacts._finish; returns reference/emitted_payload_sha256/emitted_payload_bytes. Hash bytes as emitted from validated value; verify final reference against that hash/count. No new encoding.
interfaces._prepared_namespace_identity(work_dir, t: Check exact normalized lexical roots, expected resolved paths and ordered literal aliases; capture scoped ordinary-directory device/inode/type without mutable ancestor mtime. Roots/leaves ordinary. Entry-local only.
interfaces._read_prepared_target_object(target_refe: Returns (frozen_value, entry_references, namespace_identity, phase_witness, observed_io). Exact marker/child/type/hash/nonfinite contract, same-buffer target hash/parse, one freeze and separate entry witness; no execution authority.
interfaces.prepare_pilot_target(args, design, proto: Existing prepare action pilot-target; read completed original pilot inventory via args.inventory, validate it unchanged, build exact full target, independently validate on CPU, publish target+descriptor after fresh guards. Returns preparation object reference; no model argument.
interfaces._validate_prepared_receiver_resources(re: Root-anchored exact artifact/reader/freeze/environment/recipe validation; return separate retained/extra-transient resource charges and reject insufficient actual capacity before reading/loading. No unmeasured sharing subtraction or tier reduction.
interfaces.load_prepared_pilot_target(args, design,: Production derives all expected refs and resource record from freshly validated root pilot admission/context, not caller booleans. Reads the data, seals one PID-local graph and binds exact source/part/workdir/pilot/admission/reservation references. CPU measurement uses only the lower data reader and never mints model authority.
interfaces._PreparedPilotTarget.assert_scope(args,: Reject wrong PID/seal/context/part/namespace/ref or graph replacement; data handle cannot grant execution or be serialized/reinitialized.
interfaces._PreparedPilotTarget.final_publication_b: After union+before_publication: exact entry-bound namespace/full witness; original fresh live guard/effective deadline; cheap unchanged identity/alias seal; final deadline. No adopt-current path.
interfaces.run_pilot(..., prepared_target=None): Production requires loader-minted handle and performs no target rebuild/publication/readback. Explicit injected reference path remains for differential fixtures only; fresh native aggregate must use prepared path.

root_admission_extension.rule: Whole admission body/hash remains anchored by existing original mapping. Descriptor/resource references alone never authorize a model. No new admission kind.

descriptor_required_fields: target_reference and emitted payload SHA/byte count
canonical inventory SHA and complete unchanged summary/bounds
selected full backing reference only for selected
actual normal CPU provenance/source before-after references
receiver_resources_required_fields: exact target/preparation references and source/reader/freeze code hashes
actual software environment and declared deployment/storage family
cold/warm wall/CPU/cgroup peak scope and normal-completion provenance
resource_rule: Keep original pilot/authority/model/numeric obligations and full original tiers. Add separate retained and extra-transient metadata charges; do not subtract presumed overlap. A fixture existing50+retained20+extra30 needs capacity100 and rejects99. Actual allocation contract must back root capacity. A CPU producer peak is not a receiver bound.

planned_receiver.rule: Prove actual counts; if higher, report and revise cost/feasibility before acceptance, not hide calls or weaken witnesses.

final_order: prepared_target.final_publication_barrier: namespace+full witness -> original fresh live/deadline -> cheap identity seal -> deadline
